Always a terminal inside the editor
Always the Claude Code extension
Always the Claude Desktop app

claudeHistory.skipPermissions.description: Resume and fork chats with --dangerously-skip-permissions, so Claude runs every tool without asking first. Leave it off unless that is safe where you work.

claudeHistory.pageSize.description: How many chats each folder shows before "Show more".

enumDescriptions: Most recent first
Most expensive first
Longest first
By title, A to Z
claudeHistory.sort.description: How chats are ordered inside a folder.

claudeHistory.exportDirectory.description: Where exported chats are written. Empty opens them as an unsaved editor instead.

claudeHistory.exportSourceCopy.description: Write the raw .source.jsonl next to an exported chat. It holds every tool result in full, so anything a tool printed or read - keys in a .env, say - is in it.

enumDescriptions: Your computer's date style

claudeHistory.openOnStartup.description: Show Agent Logbook in the sidebar when the editor opens or reloads, instead of the Explorer.

claudeHistory.showLiveFirst.description: Float chats that are running right now to the top of the list.

claudeHistory.topBars.markdownDescription: Which usage windows appear as bars across the top of the panel, in order - up to three. Easier to set from the Settings tab in the panel.

enumDescriptions: Chats stack in the terminal panel, as before
Chats split side by side in the bottom panel; Cmd+J hides them all
The panel sits right of your code with chats stacked in it; Cmd+J hides them all
Code on the left, chat on the right, half and half
Code takes two thirds, chat the right third
Chat takes two thirds, code the left third
Code on top, chat underneath, half and half
Code on top, chat in the bottom third
Code on the left, two chats stacked on the right
Code top left, up to three chats in the other quarters
claudeHistory.chatLayout.description: Where a resumed or new chat opens. Anything but the bottom panel opens it as a tab in a fixed spot in the editor area.

claudeHistory.limitAlerts.description: Also pop up a notification, once per window, when a quota bar you chose is flagged. The flag always shows in the panel and the status bar.

claudeHistory.resetSoonWeeklyHours.description: How close a weekly reset counts as soon, in hours.

claudeHistory.resetSoonSessionMinutes.description: How close a 5-hour reset counts as soon, in minutes.

claudeHistory.unusedPercent.description: How much has to be left unused, in percent, for a reset coming soon to be flagged.

claudeHistory.boardAllWindows.description: Show running chats from every editor window on the Live chats board, not only the chats in this window's folders.

claudeHistory.finishAlerts.description: Pop up a notification when a running chat finishes and is waiting for you. A count always shows in the status bar.
